description_en: Asynchronously starts MCP Server connectivity and tool list detection. The first call prompts you to wait one minute for resource provisioning. Subsequent calls return a temporary Session ID for polling the result
description_zh: 异步启动 MCP Server 连通性和工具列表检测，首次调用会提示需要等待一分钟拉起资源，后再次调用将返回用于轮询结果的临时 Session ID
kebab_example: aliyun dms start-list-mcp-server-tools --mcp-server-uuid 44lg000z65 --biz-language CHINESE --dms-unit cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: StartListMcpServerTools

parameters.help_en: The ID of the MCP Server for which to detect connectivity and query the tool list. Only the service creator can trigger the detection
parameters.help_zh: 要检测连通性并查询工具列表的 MCP Server ID。仅服务创建者可触发检测
parameters.name: mcp_server_uuid

parameters.help_en: The language used for the detection session
parameters.name: language

parameters.help_en: The identifier of the Data Management unit that runs the Data Agent resources
parameters.help_zh: 运行 Data Agent 资源的 DMS 单元标识
parameters.name: dms_unit

Data.description_en: The result of the asynchronous detection startup. Only StartTimestamp may be returned if the resources are still being provisioned
Data.description_zh: 异步检测启动结果。资源仍在启动时可能只返回 StartTimestamp

SessionId.description_en: The temporary session ID for this detection. After the startup succeeds, use this value to call GetListMcpServerToolsResult to poll for the result
SessionId.description_zh: 本次检测的临时会话 ID。启动成功后使用该值调用 GetListMcpServerToolsResult 轮询结果

StartTimestamp.description_en: The UNIX timestamp at which the server started the detection, in milliseconds
StartTimestamp.description_zh: 服务端启动检测的 Unix 时间戳，单位为毫秒

ErrorCode.description_en: The return code. The value success is returned if the request was successful. An error code is returned if the request failed
ErrorCode.description_zh: 返回码。请求成功时为 success；请求失败时为对应的错误码

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if a system-level request failure occurs
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 系统级请求失败时返回的错误信息

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to locate this call
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于定位本次调用

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:
true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh: 请求处理是否成功。取值为 true 表示成功，取值为 false 表示失败
